data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 梳妆台镜前浅紫真丝细带的幽香凝眸
data.description: 静谧夜色中的闺房，绫濑仅穿一件淡紫色半透真丝细吊带睡裙坐在古典梳妆台前，手握晶莹香水瓶轻喷颈侧，镜中眼眸泛着令人窒息的情感张力。
data.location: 雅致闺房欧式古典梳妆台前
data.action: 单手握水晶香水喷头按向纤细颈窝，细滑肩带微微滑落，透过化妆镜与观者视线深邃交汇
data.lighting: 梳妆台柔光镜灯与床头微暗的暖黄台灯，空气中弥漫香水微雾光泽
data.camera: 镜面中景虚实构图，兼具私密闺阁感与极致诱惑
data.promptProse: Ayase Aragaki sits before an antique mahogany dressing table in the soft intimacy of her dimly-lit bedroom. Wearing a delicate lavender silk chemise with ultra-thin shoulder straps slipping slightly down her shoulder, she holds an ornate crystal atomizer, spraying a fine fragrant mist against the curve of her neck. Her reflection in the lighted vanity mirror reveals deep, passionate eyes directed toward the observer.
data.animaCaption: In the warm glow of her vanity mirror, Ayase spritzes crystal perfume along her exposed neck with a captivating, intimate glance.
